description: Complete validation coverage, standardize remaining API routes, and perform final cleanup. Refactor remaining form submission routes (complaints, consultations, partnerships) to use withApiHandler. Add missing validation schemas. Remove duplicate email validation. This completes the refactoring effort.
steps: Add partnershipSchema to lib/utils/validation.ts with all required fields (companyName, contactPerson, email, phone, website, partnershipType, companySize, industry, servicesOffered, message, document URLs, termsAccepted)
Update serviceInquirySchema in lib/utils/validation.ts to match actual client_inquiries table fields (add/rename fields as needed)
Refactor app/api/complaints/route.ts POST to use withApiHandler
Refactor app/api/consultations/route.ts POST to use withApiHandler with consultationSchema
Refactor app/api/partnerships/route.ts POST to use withApiHandler with partnershipSchema, removing manual validation
Refactor app/api/complaints/route.ts GET to use withGetHandler
Refactor app/api/consultations/route.ts GET to use withGetHandler
Refactor app/api/partnerships/route.ts GET to use withGetHandler
Update app/api/complaints/status/route.ts to use emailSchema.safeParse() instead of manual regex
Update app/api/inquiries/status/route.ts to use emailSchema.safeParse() instead of manual regex
Run full type check: pnpm type-check
Comprehensive manual testing checklist execution (see verification section)
Review all changes, ensure no functionality broken
Stage and commit changes with descriptive commit messages
acceptance_criteria: All form submission API routes use withApiHandler wrapper
All GET list routes use withGetHandler or standardized pattern
partnershipSchema defined and used in partnerships route
serviceInquirySchema updated to match database schema
No manual email regex validation in API routes (use Zod)
All forms (contact, inquiry, complaint, consultation, newsletter, partnership) submit successfully
All admin list pages display correctly with new components
Status and priority badges render correctly everywhere
verification: Form submission tests: Contact form, Inquiry form, Complaint form, Consultation form, Newsletter subscription, Partnership application - verify all succeed and show success messages
Rate limit test: Submit contact form 4 times rapidly, verify 5th attempt is rate limited with 429 status
Validation test: Submit contact form with invalid email, verify validation error
Admin pages test: Visit contacts, inquiries, complaints, consultations, partnerships pages - verify all render correctly
Status badge test: Verify badges on all admin pages show correct colors and labels
Stats grid test: Verify counts on all admin pages are correct
Realtime test: Submit contact form, verify it appears on admin/contacts page without refresh
Mobile responsive test: Test admin pages in mobile viewport (375px width)
API error handling test: Cause a database error (e.g., invalid data) and verify proper error response
CAPTCHA test: Submit form without CAPTCHA token (if CAPTCHA is enforced), verify 403 error
Email validation test: Try status check endpoints with invalid emails, verify 400 error with proper message
